steps.intro: Welcome to the Dice Throne 1v1 tutorial. Reduce your opponent to 0 Health before they do the same to you.
steps.stats: This panel shows your resources: Health (starts at 50) and CP (starts at 2, max 15). Most healing caps at starting Health +10.
steps.phases: Turn order lives here: Upkeep → Income → Main 1 → Offensive Roll → Defensive Roll → Main 2 → Discard. The first player skips Income on their first turn.
steps.playerBoard: This is your player board: ability slots and upgrades live here, and ready abilities can be activated from this area.
steps.tipBoard: This tip board shows your hero reference and ability requirements; you can expand or collapse it anytime.
steps.dice: Your dice tray. You may roll up to 3 times each turn and lock dice you want to keep.
steps.rollButton: Use “Roll” to start rolling. When you’re satisfied or out of rolls, move to confirm.
steps.confirmButton: Confirm locks the result so you can pick a skill. If you want another roll, don’t confirm yet.
steps.abilities: Highlighted abilities are available to use. Pick one to begin attack resolution.
steps.hand: Your hand lives here. In Main phases you can play action cards or upgrades, or sell cards for CP.
steps.discard: This is the discard pile. Drag a card here to sell it for +1 CP.
steps.statusTokens: Status effects and tokens live here. Spend Evasive/Taiji/Purify at the right time; pay 2 CP before offense to remove Knockdown.
steps.advance: Use the Next Phase button to move forward. Enter offensive roll and then roll dice.
steps.resolveAttack: After choosing an offensive ability, click “Resolve Attack” to apply damage and open defense if needed.
steps.purifyUse: You gained a Purify token! Click the Purify token on the left to open the purify panel, select Knockdown, and click "Confirm" to remove it.
steps.innerPeace: Your hand has Inner Peace — play it to gain 2 Taiji tokens.
steps.playSix: Your hand has Play Six — use it during offensive roll to set a die to 6.
steps.meditation2: Your hand has Meditation II — drag it onto the Meditation ability slot to upgrade.
steps.finish: That's the 1v1 core flow. Try activating abilities, playing cards, and defeating your opponent!
steps.opponentDefense: Your opponent is rolling for defense. The defender auto-selects a defensive ability and rolls.
steps.knockdownExplain: The opponent played Palm Strike, inflicting Knockdown on you! Knockdown forces you to skip offensive roll, but you can remove it with Purify.
steps.enlightenmentPlay: Play the Enlightenment card from your hand to roll 1 die. Rolling a Lotus face grants Taiji, Evasive, and Purify tokens.
steps.sellCardIntro: You can **sell cards for CP** anytime! **Drag a card to the discard pile** on the right to sell it and gain **1 CP**. Selling is always available, regardless of phase. Try selling a card now!
steps.main2Intro: Attack resolved! Now entering Main Phase 2. You can play action or upgrade cards here, same as Main Phase 1.
steps.aiTurnIntro: Your actions are done. Now it's your opponent's turn. Watch how they play cards and attack.
steps.undoSellIntro: You can undo your last sold card! Click the discard pile on the right to take it back. Useful if you sell the wrong card by mistake.
steps.undoSell: Click the discard pile to undo the last sold card.

knockdown.name: Knockdown
description: Before the Offensive Roll Phase, you may spend 2 CP to remove this token
If not removed, you must skip the phase and remove this token

burn.name: Burn
description: Persistent. Does not stack. During Upkeep, take 2 damage.

stun.name: Stun
description: The affected player skips their next offensive roll phase and main phase.
Remove this token at the end of that phase.

concussion.name: Concussion
description: At the start of your Income phase, skip that phase and remove this token.

daze.name: Daze
description: After the current attack ends, remove this token, then the current attacker attacks again immediately.

poison.name: Poison
description: During each of your Upkeep Phases, take n damage (n = number of Poison stacks). Persistent effect.

blinded.name: Blinded
description: At the end of Offensive Roll Phase, roll 1 die. On 1-2, the attack is negated. Then remove this token.

entangle.name: Entangle
description: Your next Offensive Roll Phase has one fewer roll (3→2). Then remove this token.

targeted.name: Targeted
description: Incoming damage +2. Persistent.

bind.name: Bind
description: Each additional roll attempt costs 1 CP; remove at the end of the Offensive Roll Phase.

cursed_coin.name: Cursed Coin
description: During Upkeep, take 1 damage for each Cursed Coin.
Cursed Pirate may refuse gained coins; coins cannot be moved or removed.

powder_keg.name: Powder Keg
description: During Upkeep, roll 1 die: 1-2 explodes for 3 undefendable damage; 6 may pass it to any player.

wither.name: Wither
description: When dealing damage through the Offensive Roll Phase, reduce that damage by 1 per Wither. Persistent, limit 2.

parley.name: Parley
description: The holder cannot deal damage through the Offensive Roll Phase; remove at the end of that phase.

nanobomb.name: Nanobomb
description: Negative status effect, limit 3. When detonated, deals 1/3/5 damage by stack count. During the holder's Upkeep, roll 1 die for each stack and remove 1 stack for each 6.

confirmRemoveKnockdown.title: Remove Knockdown?
confirmRemoveKnockdown.description: Spend 2 CP to remove Knockdown, allowing you to proceed with the Offensive Roll Phase this turn.

taiji.name: Taiji
description: At any time, spend 1 Taiji to reduce incoming damage by 1
Before attacking, spend 1 Taiji to increase damage by 1
Taiji gained this turn cannot be used to boost damage this turn

evasive.name: Evasive
description: When taking damage, you may spend 1 Evasive and roll 1 die
On 1-2, damage becomes 0 (other effects still apply)
You may spend multiple Evasive to retry in the same attack

purify.name: Purify
description: At any time, spend 1 Purify to remove 1 negative status token

fire_mastery.name: Fire Mastery
description: During Upkeep, remove 1 Fire Mastery token (cooldown).

sneak.name: Sneak
description: When you would take damage from an Offensive Roll Phase, prevent that damage and skip the Defensive Roll (the attack is still considered 'successful' and other effects may trigger)
After completing one full turn with this token, discard it at end of turn

sneak_attack.name: Sneak Attack
description: At the end of an Offensive Roll Phase, you may spend this token to roll 1🎲 and add the result to this attack's damage
Cannot be used to enhance Collateral Damage

crit.name: Crit
description: When your attack deals ≥5 damage, you may spend this token to deal +4 damage. Cannot be used on collateral damage. Does not stack.

accuracy.name: Accuracy
description: At the end of your Offensive Roll Phase, you may spend this token to make this attack undefendable. Does not stack.

protect.name: Protect
description: At any time, spend this token to halve incoming damage (rounded up). Does not stack.

retribution.name: Retribution
description: When taking attack damage, spend this token to reflect half the damage (rounded up) to the attacker. Does not reduce your own damage taken. Does not stack.

tithes_upgraded.name: Tithes Upgraded
description: Passive ability upgraded to Tithes II

blessing_of_divinity.name: Blessing of Divinity
description: When your HP drops to 0, remove this token and set HP to 1. This token cannot be removed, transferred, or stolen. Does not stack.

loaded.name: Loaded
description: At the end of your Offensive Roll Phase, you may spend 1 Loaded and roll 1 die.
Add half the result, rounded up, as bonus damage to this attack.

knockdown.name: Knockdown
description: During an attack, this status forces you to skip the Offensive Roll Phase.
You can remove it with Purify.

bounty.name: Bounty
description: A player with Bounty takes +1 damage from incoming attacks.
The attacker gains 1 additional CP.
Bounty does not remove itself automatically.

honor.name: Honor
description: Before your attack deals damage, you may spend 1 or 2 Honor:
Spend 1 to increase damage by 1; spend 2 to increase damage by 3.

shame.name: Shame
description: When calculating attack damage, remove Shame by stacks.
Each 1 removed reduces that attack's damage by 1.

samurai_retribution.name: Back Strike
description: When taking attack damage, spend 1 Back Strike and roll 1 die.
Deal half the result, rounded up, back to the attacker.
This does not reduce the damage you take.

treant_seedling.name: Seedling Spirit
description: Limit 3. During your roll phase, spend 1 to reroll one of your dice. Each Spirit type may be spent only once per turn.

treant_sapling.name: Sapling Spirit
description: Limit 2. During your main phase, spend 1 to heal 1 and gain 1 CP; or also spend 1 CP to draw 1 card. Each Spirit type may be spent only once per turn.

treant_divine.name: Divine Spirit
description: Limit 1. Before dealing damage, spend it to add +3 damage. At the end of an opponent's Offensive Roll phase, if their attack would apply a negative status to you, you may spend it to prevent that status. Each Spirit type may be spent only once per turn.

life_sap.name: Life Sap
description: Limit 1. During your main phase, spend it and roll 1 die, then heal half the value rounded up.

thorn.name: Thorn
description: Limit 1. During offensive roll, each additional roll attempt deals 1 damage to its owner, up to 2 damage per turn this way; remove it at the end of the roll phase.

delayed_poison.name: Delayed Poison
description: Limit 2. At the end of your turn, remove all Delayed Poison and take 3 damage per stack.

ninjutsu.name: Ninjutsu
description: Limit 3. Before dealing damage, spend it and roll 1 die: 1-3 adds +1 damage; 4-5 adds +2 damage; 6 lets you choose +2 damage plus Delayed Poison, or +2 damage and make the attack undefendable.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
description: Limit 1. Before receiving damage, spend it and roll 1 die; on 1-3, prevent that damage.

tactical_advantage.name: Tactical Advantage
description: Limit 5. Spend 1 to gain 1 CP or reroll 1 die; spend 3 to draw 1 or inflict Targeted on 1 opponent; spend 4 to let 1 player gain Protect or transfer 1 status.

synth.name: Synth
description: Artificer resource token, limit 7. Used to build bots, upgrade basic bots, or inflict Nanobomb on an opponent.

nanobot.name: Nanobot
description: Companion bot, base limit 1, upgraded limit 2. Can activate during Upkeep to detonate all Nanobombs.

shock_bot.name: Shock Bot
description: Companion bot, base limit 1, upgraded limit 2. Can activate after dealing attack damage to add +3 attack damage.

heal_bot.name: Heal Bot
description: Companion bot, base limit 1, upgraded limit 2. Can activate after receiving at least 6 attack damage and roll to heal.

card-you-should-be-ashamed.name: You Should Be Ashamed!
card-you-should-be-ashamed.description: Choose an opponent. That opponent gains 2 Shame.

card-righteousness.name: Righteousness!
card-righteousness.description: Roll 1 die and gain that face's effect: Katana adds 2 damage; Helm inflicts 2 Shame on your opponent; Rising Sun grants you 1 Back Strike.

card-zanshin.name: Zanshin!
card-zanshin.description: Roll 5 additional dice. Each Katana adds 1 damage to this attack, each Helm inflicts 1 Shame, and each Rising Sun grants you 1 Back Strike.

treant-card-trample.name: Trample!
treant-card-trample.description: Roll 5 dice. Each Branch adds +1 attack damage. If this card added at least +3 damage, apply Thorn.

upgrade-tend-care-2.name: Tend & Care II
upgrade-tend-care-2.description: Upgrade Tend & Care: draw 1; cultivate 4 Spirits; choose 1 player to gain Life Sap; choose 1 opponent to receive Thorn.

upgrade-rooted-2.name: Rooted II
upgrade-rooted-2.description: Upgrade Rooted: roll 4 defense dice; prevent damage equal to Branch + Spirit rolled. If you roll 2 Leaf, cultivate 1 Spirit. If you roll 2 Spirit, choose 1 player to gain Life Sap.

treant-card-drink-deep.name: Drink Deep!
treant-card-drink-deep.description: Choose 1 player to gain Life Sap.

upgrade-shattering-fist-3.name: Shattering Fist III
upgrade-shattering-fist-3.description: Upgrade Shattering Fist: 3/4/5 Branch deal 5/6/7 damage. If you rolled 3 matching values, cultivate 1 Spirit. Apply Thorn.

treant-card-harvest.name: Harvest!
treant-card-harvest.description: Remove up to 3 Spirits. Gain 1 CP per removed Spirit. If you removed at least 2 Spirits, up to 2 players gain Life Sap.

treant-card-downpour.name: Downpour!
treant-card-downpour.description: You may cultivate each current Spirit once, in any order.

upgrade-nature-touch-2.name: Nature Touch II
upgrade-nature-touch-2.description: Upgrade Nature Touch: 4 Spirit; cultivate 2 Spirits, then deal 6 undefendable damage. +1 damage for each Spirit you have.

treant-card-soulfire.name: Soulfire!
treant-card-soulfire.description: Roll 3 dice: Branch deals 1 collateral damage to all opponents; Leaf gains Life Sap; Spirit cultivates 1 Spirit.

treant-card-mother-tree.name: Mother Tree!
treant-card-mother-tree.description: Roll 1 die. If you roll Spirit, cultivate 4 Spirits. Otherwise, draw 1.

upgrade-vengeful-vines-2.name: Vengeful Vines II
upgrade-vengeful-vines-2.description: Upgrade Vengeful Vines: small straight; apply Thorn; deal 8 damage.

upgrade-wild-growth-2.name: Wild Roar II
upgrade-wild-growth-2.description: Upgrade Wild Roar: Large Straight deals 8 damage, then roll 5 dice; each Branch +1 damage; if you roll a Leaf, gain Life Sap; each Spirit cultivates 1 Spirit. Dazzle Bloom (2 Branch + 2 Spirit): inflict Thorn and deal 4 undefendable damage.

upgrade-shattering-fist-2.name: Shattering Fist II
upgrade-shattering-fist-2.description: Upgrade Shattering Fist: 3/4/5 Branch deal 5/6/7 damage and apply Thorn.

upgrade-blink-2.name: Blink II
upgrade-blink-2.description: Upgrade Blink: defensive roll 3 dice; you may reroll up to 2 of those dice; deal damage equal to the number of Ninja Blades rolled; if you roll a Shuriken, deal 2 damage; if you roll 2 Masks, gain 1 Smoke Bomb.

upgrade-going-forward-2.name: Going Forward II
upgrade-going-forward-2.description: Upgrade Going Forward: 4 Shuriken rolls 2 dice and deals damage equal to the total; you may reroll 1 die; if the final total is 6 or less, this attack becomes undefendable. Blood on the Tip (3 Shuriken): roll 1 die and deal direct damage equal to the value rolled.

upgrade-slash-2.name: Slash II
upgrade-slash-2.description: Upgrade Slash: 3/4/5 Ninja Blade deal 4/6/8 damage; if you rolled 3 of the same number, gain 1 Ninjutsu.

upgrade-shadow-step-2.name: Shadow Step II
upgrade-shadow-step-2.description: Upgrade Shadow Step: 4 Mask gains 1 Smoke Bomb, inflicts 2 Delayed Poison, and deals 5 undefendable damage. Strangle (3 Mask): gain 3 Ninjutsu; inflict 2 Delayed Poison on 1 opponent.

ninja-card-shuriken.name: Shuriken!
ninja-card-shuriken.description: Roll 5 dice; each Ninja Blade adds +1 attack damage.

ninja-card-escape.name: Escape!
ninja-card-escape.description: Play after being attacked; reduce damage or gain Smoke Bomb by die result.

upgrade-smoke-screen-2.name: Smoke Screen II
upgrade-smoke-screen-2.description: Upgrade Smoke Screen: 1 Ninja Blade + 2 Shuriken + 1 Mask lets 1 player gain 1 Smoke Bomb and 3 Ninjutsu, then inflicts 1 Delayed Poison on 1 opponent. Kuji-kiri (3 Shuriken + 2 Mask): deal 4 direct damage to 2 opponents; you may choose the same opponent twice.

upgrade-shadow-fang-2.name: Shadow Fang II
upgrade-shadow-fang-2.description: Upgrade Shadow Fang: Large Straight gains 1 Smoke Bomb and 2 Ninjutsu, then deals 8 damage. Deceive (2 Ninja Blade + 2 Mask): gain 1 Smoke Bomb and deal 2 undefendable damage.

upgrade-poison-blade-2.name: Poison Blade II
upgrade-poison-blade-2.description: Upgrade Poison Blade: Small Straight rolls 1 die; Ninja Blade inflicts 1 Delayed Poison, Shuriken or Mask inflicts 2 Delayed Poison, then deal 5 damage.

upgrade-death-blossom-2.name: Death Blossom II
upgrade-death-blossom-2.description: Upgrade Death Blossom: 3 Ninja Blade + 2 Shuriken rolls 5 dice; deal 1 damage per Ninja Blade plus 2 damage per Shuriken; 1 Mask makes this attack undefendable; 2 Masks inflict Delayed Poison; you may reroll up to 2 dice.

ninja-card-dojo.name: Dojo!
ninja-card-dojo.description: Roll 1 die. If you roll Mask, gain Smoke Bomb and 2 Ninjutsu. Otherwise, draw 1.

treantSapling.name: Sapling Spirit
treantSapling.draw: Spend Sapling and 1 CP to draw 1

zhanshujiaTacticalAdvantage.cp: Spend 1 Tactical Advantage to gain 1 CP

zhanshujiaTacticalAdvantage.protect: Spend 4 Tactical Advantage to gain 1 Protect
zhanshujiaTacticalAdvantage.transfer: Spend 4 Tactical Advantage to transfer 1 status effect
